research_question: What mathematical machinery and derivations are needed to teach Human-AI Productivity Paradoxes in full, excluding the convex-cost extension?
search_scope: Primary-source reconstruction of arXiv:2605.11350v1, including the main text and supplementary Appendices A-C; Appendix D is excluded at the user's request.

sources.title: Human-AI Productivity Paradoxes: Modeling the Interplay of Skill, Effort, and AI Assistance
sources.version_read: v1, 12 May 2026; local PDF and arXiv TeX source

claims.claim: In the deterministic basic model, optimal effort is the positive part of x-star minus skill and AI assistance, while productivity is weakly increasing in skill plus assistance.
claims.evidence_note: Re-derived from concavity and the change of variable x=s+e+a.

claims.claim: Endogenous skill development can create an increasing-then-decreasing productivity region when the sensitivity gap is positive and memory decay is sufficiently large.
claims.evidence_note: Derivative formula, single-crossing argument, and large-mu polynomial asymptotics independently reconstructed.

claims.claim: Under unreliable AI, IARA yields an initially decreasing and then possibly increasing productivity profile, while DARA yields increasing productivity.
claims.evidence_note: Implicit differentiation of effort and substitution into the productivity derivative reproduced step by step.

claims.claim: Skill-dependent verification accuracy can make expected effort non-monotone in skill and thereby permit a multimodal stationary skill distribution.
claims.evidence_note: Bayesian posteriors, threshold crossings, piecewise effort derivatives, and adjacent-probability ratio test reconstructed.

limitations: This is a theoretical model with additive substitutability and myopic users.
The main skill-polarization theorem uses a capped linear production function.
The convex-cost extension in Appendix D is deliberately excluded.
sources.notes: The tutorial distinguishes paper results from added pedagogical commentary and algebraic expansions.

search_log.notes: Primary source supplied by the user.
Used to recover exact mathematical notation and proof structure.

well_established: The deterministic optimizer characterization follows directly from concavity.
The stationary distribution follows from detailed balance for a finite birth-death chain.
The sign formula in the unreliability model follows from implicit differentiation.
unverified: The empirical studies cited in the paper were not independently audited because the requested artifact is a tutorial of this paper's mathematics.
researcher_inferences: The dependency map, lecture sequencing, worked checks, and diagnostic questions are pedagogical additions, not claims made by the paper.
